certified_behavior: The capability is executed only after an explicit net_margin_real request.
The governed computation plan must be ready and semantic bindings confirmed.
Each required variable must resolve deterministically from normalized evidence.
The evaluator computes net margin amount and percentage.
The evaluator classifies positive margin, break-even or negative margin.
A bounded finding and deterministic treatment are produced without causal attribution.
explicit_limits: REN_001 does not infer why a margin is positive, zero or negative.
REN_001 does not identify responsibility, fraud, pricing error or accounting error.
The cycle does not add other pathologies, scrap or OEE capabilities.
